name: Face close-up
description: Tight beauty close-up framed from just above the hairline to the collarbones: the face fills the frame, lips, cheeks, dimples, brows and eyes in razor-sharp detail, the hair framing the face and falling out of frame
notes: Reference shot for facial features (lips, cheeks, dimples, iris detail) when a face needs to be forced into a pose via multi-image.
